opening.argument: The wording and display work together. The title promotes a “Forsage BUSD” income-generating plan, explicitly identifies MLM and network marketing, and directs viewers to make contact. The frame then shows three people joining and earning 42 lakh 43,000 rupees or more in 70 days, circles a result of 54,886 BUSD, and declares, “THIS IS THE POWER OF OUR SYSTEM.” Repeatedly presenting new participants alongside large BUSD results makes recruitment-dependent income appear as a compelling opportunity, rather than analysis or criticism.
